test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
If,

'C % D' means 'C is the brother of D',

'C & D' means 'C is the mother of D',

'C × D' means 'C is the husband of D',

'C # D' means 'C is the sister of D',

'C $ D' means 'C is the son of D',

'C @ D' means 'C is the father of D',

then how is P related to U in the following expression?

P # Q % R & D $ T @ U
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 **Symbol**
 $
 @
 #
 %
 &
 ×
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Father
 Sister
 Brother
 Mother
 Husband
 
 

 

Given : P # Q % R & D $ T @ U

It means P is the sister of Q, Q is the brother of R, R is the mother of D, D is the son of T, T is the father of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b789be0525bd46cecff0b1b790813e59bb27015fe5b12cd4d6d87a847a79356.png] 

Thus, P is the Mother's sister of U.

Hence, the correct answer is** " Option 2".**
